steps.description: Just want to run a few last suggestions by you before you go on to finish...

description.text: Cash in all of your steps with the **Silent Peddler**. I recommend stocking up on **Thera Extracts**.

items.text: If you're going to be grinding for levels, be sure to equip the **Pedometer** and **Accelerator** while you're doing it.
You can easily earn enough steps to buy whatever you like.

steps.description: Spend the money using **Meiyuan**'s Acupuncture to increase the **Hit Area** and/or Attack Power of your ultimate weapons.

description.text: Stock up on the following items, if you have the cash and/or steps.

items.text: If you had ground everyone to get their final special skills, you should have a ton of both.
The **Third Keys** make for **much** easier boss battles.
And yes, these quantities are probably a bit high. Better safe than sorry.

If you don't have the extra money for Extracts right now, the enemies in **[W-2-17] Neameeto** can drop them, so if you have those sets of **Pirate Earrings**, you can get them to drop 100% if you equip 5 of them, or 4 of them and the **Thief Earrings**.
**Thera Extract** (50+ from the **Silent Peddler**)
**Mana Root** (50+ from **Roger's Vending Machine**)
**Mana Extract** (10-15 or so from the **Tight-lipped Merchant** in **Prague**)
**Pure Root** (25 or so from the **Tight-lipped Merchant** in **Prague**)
**Pure Extract** (5-10 or so from the **Tight-lipped Merchant** in **Prague**)
**Third Keys** (5-10 or so from the **Tight-lipped Merchant** in **Prague**)

steps.description: Learn all of **Yuri**'s ???? Fusion skills by going **Berserk** in battle, fused as the monster you want to learn the ability with.

description.text: If you want to, you can grind everyone to the following levels to have all of their special skills. Here in **[W-2-17] Neameeto** is the best place for EXP and Gold in the game.

items.text: **Alice** - 48
**Zhuzhen** - 47
**Margarete** - 46
**Keith** - 49
**Halley** - 47

description.text: Grinding Equipment Suggestions (to maximize Steps, Cash, and EXP):

items.text: **Brigand Earrings** x6, 1 per party member (purchased in Asia)
**Thief Earrings** x1, equip on ANY party member (won from Lottery)
**Pedometer** x1, equip on an active party member (from **Silent Peddler**)
**Accelerator** x1, equip with the **Pedometer** (won from Lottery)
**Monk Earrings** x2, active party members to boost EXP (**Olga**/Orphanage)

description.text: This should give you +140% Cash, Double Pedometer steps, and +40% EXP for those two who have the **Monk Earrings** equipped.
Make sure everyone (yes, all six members) has their best equipment AND a set of accessories equipped.

items.text: Also, make sure they're at **least** level 40 or higher before moving on.
There's a point in **[W-2-17] Neameeto** that your party is split in two, and your preferred party may not be the one doing the fighting.
I strongly recommend leveling until they have their final skills as mentioned above.

steps.description: Once you feel you've done everything you want to do, head to **[W-2-17] Neameeto** to finish what we've started...
